name: MessageGuard
description: Filters outgoing messages for secrets and sensitive data before they are sent.

enabled.label: Enable MessageGuard
enabled.help: When disabled, all messages pass through unfiltered.

scriptPath.label: Path to filter_message.py
scriptPath.help: Absolute or ~ path to the MessageGuard filter script.

configPath.label: Path to filter config (optional)
configPath.help: Optional path to a YAML/JSON config file for MessageGuard patterns and mode.
